tools.description: Unified audit tool. Primary action: query_audit (GraphQL-feel modules + presets). Also: compare_audit_snapshots, plus legacy route/content/policy/security/recommendation/comparison/export/summary actions.

action.description: The action to perform. Available actions: query_audit: Unified GraphQL-feel audit. Select audit modules (seo, accessibility, performance, conversion, visual, technical, privacyTrust, structuredData, crawl), presets, scores, issues, roadmap, report, and snapshots in one call. compare_audit_snapshots: Compare two audit snapshots (by ID) and report score deltas, new issues, resolved issues, and changed modules. site_route: Audit site routes and links for broken routes, invalid links, duplicate titles, missing canonicals, redirects, and route health. content_consistency: Detect pricing, subscription, feature-count, product-identity, and limitation contradictions across crawled pages. extension_policy: Review site/listing/manifest copy for Chrome extension policy and claim-safety risks. client_side_security: Inspect client-side storage for Pro/license flags, exposed secrets, debug flags, tokens, and sensitive state with redacted evidence. reveal_client_security_value: Reveal one exact redacted client-storage value after an explicit scoped agent request, and log the reveal. recommendations_rank: Deduplicate and rank issues by impact, severity, confidence, project type, and affected pages. compare_runs: Compare two stored audit runs for added/resolved issues and high-level performance/evidence changes. export_package: Export a stored audit result as a ZIP package with report.md, issues.json, summary.json, and evidence/result.json. summary: Return a stored audit result in an agent-friendly summary mode such as developer, seo, compliance, conversion, detailed, short, or json-only. sensitive_session_check: Classify whether a URL appears sensitive/private before deep authenticated-page scraping.

tools.description: God's Eye — cross-tab browser monitoring. Watch chosen tabs, or every open tab with all: true: live network traffic, console errors, JS exceptions, DOM mutations, WebSocket frames. Lock onto a target tab for enhanced capture (auto-screenshots on errors). Plant tripwires that fire silently when conditions hit any tab.

action.description: The action to perform. Available actions: scan: One-shot snapshot of ALL open browser tabs: URL, title, load status, audible state. The God's Eye view of your entire browser. start_watch: Attach DevTools to the given tabs, or to every open http(s) tab with all: true, and begin capturing network requests, console output, JS errors, DOM mutations, and WebSocket frames in real time. Requires tabs or all: true. stop_watch: Detach from all watched tabs and stop the live capture session. Returns a session summary. get_feed: Pull the live event feed from the active watch session — all network traffic, console messages, errors, and DOM changes across every watched tab, sorted newest-first. lock_target: Lock onto a specific tab as the primary target. On a locked tab, JS errors trigger an automatic screenshot so you can see exactly what the user saw when things broke. unlock_target: Release the current target lock and return to standard multi-tab monitoring. set_tripwire: Plant a tripwire that fires silently the moment a matching event hits any watched tab. Check get_tripwires to see which ones have fired. get_tripwires: List all active tripwires and whether any have fired, including the timestamp and event that triggered them. clear_tripwire: Remove a tripwire by its ID. get_status: Get current God's Eye session status: whether a watch is active, how many tabs are watched, which tab is locked, event count, and tripwire summary. auto_track: Auto-attach to every newly-created or newly-navigated http(s) tab while the watch is active. Only allowed in a watch started with all: true. Toggle with enabled: true/false. watch_person: Tail an identity (email, user id, name, etc.) across every watched tab. Events whose URL, request body, console text, or error text contain the identity are tagged target_hit: true. open_incognito: Open an incognito window, or add a new incognito tab to an existing incognito window. Pass url to navigate, or urls (array) to open multiple tabs in one window. Pass windowId to attach a new tab to that existing incognito window instead of creating a new one. list_incognito: List every incognito window currently open and the tabs inside each one (id, url, title, active). close_incognito: Close an incognito window (by windowId), a specific incognito tab (by tabId), or all incognito windows (pass all: true). Errors if the target window/tab is not incognito. get_report: Generate a session report: top domains by request count, errors by tab and type, timeline of key moments (first error, first 5xx, first JS exception, first tripwire fire), tripwire summary, identity hits, and locked-target screenshot count.
